reason: Abstract presents RL infrastructure to train LLM agents and decouple execution from training; this is training-only. Primary abstract: We present Agent Lightning, a flexible and extensible framework that enables Reinforcement Learning (RL)-based training of Large Language Models (LLMs) for any AI agent. title: Agent Lightning: Train ANY AI Agents with Reinforcement Learning
